newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Tung Fong Hung plans HK$200 mln conv note.
newsitem.headline: Tung Fong Hung plans HK$200 mln conv note.

text.p: Chinese medicines retailer Tung Fong Hung (Holdings) Ltd said on Friday it plans to issue HK$200 million in unsecured convertible loan notes at an initial conversion price of HK$0.55 per share.
The conversion price represented a premium of about 5.8 percent to Thursday's closing price of HK$0.52 per share, it said in a statement.
The three-year notes will carry annual interest of seven percent.
Upon full conversion of the notes, about 363.63 million new shares will be issued, representing about 20.6 percent of the existing issued share capital, it said.
Tung Fong Hung said the net proceeds of about HK$195 million from the note issue will be used for general working capital. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6369
